mentions.name: SaaSufy
mentions.description: A no-code backend platform for building complex web apps, designed to make application architecture accessible with a light, declarative and scalable developer experience that avoids abstract technical hurdles. It was originally aimed at bringing junior devs on par with top senior devs and has since pivoted to be used by AI, which is even better at using it than a junior dev.
mentions.problem: Bridging the gap between junior and senior developers in application architecture while eliminating abstract technical hurdles in backend development.
mentions.audience: Junior developers as well as AI agents, which the platform was pivoted to serve
mentions.source_excerpt:
The most versatile and secure no-code backend platform ever created for building complex web apps. The original goal was to bring junior devs on par with top senior devs in terms of application architecture. I've been trying to create a dev experience that avoids any kind of abstract technical hurdles and makes everything as light, declarative and scalable as possible. Pivoted for AI; which is even better at using it than a junior dev. I started building this project piece by piece 15 years ago.

https://saasufy.com/
